create.name: Centro Terra di Unificazione Ewam
create.bio:
Centro Terra di Unificazione Ewam is a Florence association, founded in 1986, for the study and practice of Tibetan Buddhist philosophy, psychology and meditation in the Mahayana tradition of the Gelug school. It belongs to the FPMT, the international network of Dharma centres started by Lama Yeshe and Lama Zopa Rinpoche, and to the Italian Buddhist Union, and it places itself under the spiritual guidance of the Dalai Lama, publicly excluding Shugden practice from all its activities. From 2000 until his death at the centre in 2011 its resident teacher was Tulku Gyatso Rinpoche, a Sera Je geshe who had spent years in Chinese labour camps; a stupa in the courtyard holds his relics.

The centre is non-sectarian and open to Buddhists and non-Buddhists alike, with membership required to take part. It runs a two-year study and meditation course inspired by the Dalai Lama's teachings, followed online with monthly sessions in Florence, along with introductory courses, a short FPMT Basic Program and guided samatha-vipassana meditation every Wednesday evening and one Saturday a month. Visiting geshes from the nearby Lama Tzong Khapa Institute teach there too. The YouTube channel keeps an archive of Tulku Gyatso's Italian-translated teachings on patience, bodhicitta, guru yoga and death in the Tibetan tradition.

courses.title: Alla scoperta del Buddhismo – NUOVO CICLO! – con Marcello Macini
courses.description: A two-year course of study and meditation inspired by Tibetan tradition and the Dalai Lama's teachings, held online on Tuesday evenings with the first lesson of each month streamed from the Florence centre; open to beginners and experienced students, with notes and recordings provided.

courses.title: Meditazione Samatha Vipassana
courses.description: Guided calm-abiding and insight meditation every Wednesday evening and one Saturday a month, in person in Florence and online at the same time, led by experienced practitioners; beginners' courses run from time to time.

courses.title: Corso “Piccolo Basic”
courses.description: A shorter version of the FPMT Basic Program, a structured course through the main subjects of the Buddhist path in the Gelug tradition.

courses.title: Diventa socio – tessera annuale
courses.description: Annual membership of the association, required for taking part in the centre's courses and activities.

flags: Shugden check: the homepage mentions Shugden only in a 'Dichiarazione estraneità culto di Dogyal Shugden' — a joint declaration by Italian Gelug centres rejecting the practice; the centre excludes it. Not a NgalSo-type case.
The site still calls Lama Zopa Rinpoche the spiritual director (he died in 2023); not repeated in the bio.
Channel is an archive: 25 videos, all of the late Tulku Gyatso, latest upload Nov 2020.
Contact email is a gmail address published on the site's contact page.
Tulku Gyatso's page describes him giving 'advice on health' and describes his body not decomposing after death; descriptive, not health offerings.
Teachers not on Spiritpedia; teachers file empty. Not related to the skipped 'Ewam Garden of One Thousand Buddhas' (US).
